_meta.description: Continuously updated index of solved problems from adjacent fields, keyed by problem structure. Agents query this before finalizing hypotheses to surface non-obvious analytical paths.
_meta.update_policy: Updated via cdi_update.py when external retrieval, analyst mid-task discovery, or Phase 7 imports a new analogue.

analogues.problem_structure: Detecting coordinated behavior in a large population where individual actors appear normal
analogues.source_solution: Contact-tracing + SEIR model transmission network analysis. Treat actors as nodes; shared temporal activity creates edges; compute reproduction number R₀ for spread.
analogues.analytics_translation: API accounts as nodes; correlated activity windows create edges in a temporal graph; R₀ for abuse spread characterizes cluster coherence and growth potential
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Individual API calls look like random noise; coordinated abuse looks like disease spread — clusters, temporal correlation, superspreaders

analogues.problem_structure: Detecting the moment a cluster crosses a threshold at which collective behavior becomes self-sustaining
analogues.source_solution: Percolation threshold: the critical density at which a random network transitions from disconnected components to a spanning cluster. Below threshold: isolated behaviors. Above threshold: coordinated, self-reinforcing behavior.
analogues.analytics_translation: Monitor the connectivity of the account graph. When cluster density crosses the percolation threshold, coordinated abuse becomes self-reinforcing. The threshold is a leading indicator, not a lagging one.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Abuse cluster formation has the same phase-transition signature as percolation in a random graph

analogues.problem_structure: Detecting gradual drift in a system before threshold breach
analogues.source_solution: Critical slowing down: as a dynamical system approaches a tipping point, its recovery rate from small perturbations slows. This slowdown is detectable before the actual transition.
analogues.analytics_translation: Monitor autocorrelation in pipeline PSI scores. Increasing autocorrelation is an early warning of impending structural break — detectable weeks before PSI threshold is crossed.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Gradual pipeline degradation = approach to tipping point; PSI autocorrelation = critical slowing down signal

analogues.problem_structure: Sequential detection of a change in a rate process before a fixed threshold is crossed
analogues.source_solution: CUSUM (Cumulative Sum Control Chart): accumulates deviations from a target rate; detects subtle rate shifts that individual observations miss. SPRT is the Bayesian generalization.
analogues.analytics_translation: Apply SPRT to safety_bypass incident rate per cluster_b account. Detect rate change at month 4 before threshold-based rules trigger at month 7.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Safety bypass escalation = mean shift in a Poisson process; SPRT is the optimal sequential test for Poisson mean shifts

analogues.problem_structure: Distinguishing genuine long-term signal from novelty-driven short-term effect
analogues.source_solution: Hawthorne effect decay model: initial response to change decays as novelty wears off. Model decay curve explicitly; estimate long-run steady-state.
analogues.analytics_translation: Fit exponential decay model to week-by-week experiment effect sizes. If fitted decay rate is significant and asymptote is near zero, report as novelty effect rather than genuine treatment effect.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Experiment novelty effect = Hawthorne effect; same decay structure, same confounding mechanism

analogues.problem_structure: Characterizing the financial impact of low-frequency, high-severity events
analogues.source_solution: Extreme value theory (EVT): fit a generalized Pareto distribution to the tail of loss events. Estimate Value at Risk (VaR) and Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) at 95th/99th percentiles.
analogues.analytics_translation: Fit GPD to financial_impact tail. Report 99th-percentile single-event loss and expected annual maximum loss. More informative than mean + standard deviation for fat-tailed distributions.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Financial fraud losses are fat-tailed (power-law or Pareto distributed); standard mean/variance is misleading for risk quantification

analogues.problem_structure: Designing a detection system that adversaries will try to game
analogues.source_solution: Mosaic theory: no single source is conclusive; the pattern formed by combining many individually innocent data points reveals the target. Adversaries can suppress individual signals but cannot suppress the mosaic.
analogues.analytics_translation: Anti-abuse detection should not rely on any single metric crossing a threshold. Combine: timing correlation, token count similarity, content category drift, spend pattern, session clustering. Each individually gameable; collectively not.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Coordinated abuse = adversarial actor trying to hide in normal population; mosaic detection = game-theoretic-robust signal combination

analogues.problem_structure: Estimating the causal effect of a policy change when randomized assignment was not possible
analogues.source_solution: Difference-in-differences (DiD) or synthetic control method. Use control group whose trend matched treatment group pre-intervention to construct the counterfactual.
analogues.analytics_translation: When a regulatory event changes behavior for accounts in one jurisdiction, use accounts in other jurisdictions as the control group. Estimate causal effect of regulation on abuse rates.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Regulatory event = natural experiment; jurisdictional variation = treatment/control assignment

analogues.problem_structure: Understanding why an automated system behaves differently from its reference specification
analogues.source_solution: Fault tree analysis (FTA): top-down deductive failure analysis. Start from the observed failure, decompose into all possible causing events, trace to root causes. Used in aircraft incident investigation.
analogues.analytics_translation: When a pipeline behaves unexpectedly (PSI spike, schema drift, row count delta), build a fault tree from the observed failure. Each branch is a testable hypothesis. Prune by data evidence.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Unexpected pipeline behavior = system failure event; fault tree decomposition = root-cause analysis protocol

analogues.problem_structure: Compounding improvement across multiple cycles using exploration vs. exploitation tradeoff
analogues.source_solution: Somatic hypermutation in B-cell affinity maturation: during germinal center response, B-cells undergo mutation rates 10^6x higher than baseline. Forced exploration by biological law — even successful antibodies are mutated to find better variants.
analogues.analytics_translation: The Algorithmic Rule's 10% exploration budget is this mechanism. Exploration cycles draw from Constraint Register (currently-disbelieved hypotheses). Specified design target, not a measured result: the model projects capability plateauing at ~1.65x without exploration versus ~11.5x at cycle 50 with it. Projection only — not an observed outcome.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Analytical capability accumulation = affinity maturation; exploration budget = hypermutation rate; Constraint Register = population of dispreferred variants to try

analogues.problem_structure: Diagnosing the underlying cause of a pipeline failure when symptoms could fit multiple disease states
analogues.source_solution: Differential diagnosis: enumerate every disease that could produce the observed presentation, rank by prior probability conditioned on context, run ordered cheapest-first tests that maximally separate the hypotheses, treat the highest posterior. Triage by severity-vs-time-window; first-do-no-harm (primum non nocere) — when the cure is riskier than the disease, observe rather than intervene.
analogues.analytics_translation: Healing Agent: enumerate failure hypotheses (schema drift, upstream skew, generator regression, scale change), rank by prior on this pipeline class, run quickest-to-execute test that separates them (row count vs. PSI vs. schema hash). Apply lowest-risk-reversible remedy first. If candidate remedy is destructive and the failure is non-degrading, observe one more cycle before acting.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Failure presentation in a pipeline = clinical presentation in a patient; PSI/schema/latency signals = diagnostic tests; remediation = treatment; first-do-no-harm = reversibility-weighted scoring; triage = L0–L4 severity ladder

repair_strategies.name: differential_diagnosis_triage
repair_strategies.description: Enumerate hypotheses, run cheapest discriminating test, treat highest posterior

repair_strategies.name: first_do_no_harm_observe
repair_strategies.description: When candidate remedy is destructive and failure is non-degrading, observe one more cycle

analogues.problem_structure: Localizing a failure to its stress concentrator and routing around the weak point
analogues.source_solution: Stress-concentrator localization: catastrophic failures originate at micro-defects where stress accumulates non-uniformly (notches, voids, grain boundaries). Find the concentrator; redesign so that load redistributes around it. Pair with fail-safe defaults: when load exceeds spec, fall back to a known-good state rather than progress past the elastic limit.
analogues.analytics_translation: Healing Agent: when a pipeline fails, identify the single component (transformation step, schema field, parameter) where the failure originates. Quarantine that step and route around it with a fail-safe default value (last known good, or median). The downstream pipeline degrades gracefully rather than cascading.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Pipeline failure cascade = stress-concentrator-driven fracture; quarantine + default = load redistribution + fail-safe; the weakest link sets the system's effective tolerance

repair_strategies.name: stress_concentrator_quarantine
repair_strategies.description: Identify the failing step, quarantine, route around with fail-safe default

repair_strategies.name: fail_safe_default_substitution
repair_strategies.description: Replace the failed value/row with last known good or median

analogues.problem_structure: Restoring homeostasis after a perturbation without losing memory of the perturbation
analogues.source_solution: Homeostatic restoration: living systems detect departures from setpoint and apply negative-feedback corrections proportional to the deviation. Coupled with isolate-and-remember: when an invading pattern is detected, immune system isolates it (granuloma, neutrophil swarm) and retains a record (memory B-cells) for faster future response. Graceful apoptosis: when a cell is irrecoverable, it self-destructs without spilling damage into neighbors.
analogues.analytics_translation: Healing Agent: when a metric drifts, apply a proportional correction (smoothing, re-baselining) that returns the system to setpoint without erasing the drift signal. Log the drift signature for future faster recognition. When a record is fully corrupted (cannot be coerced), drop it cleanly with an audit log rather than letting it propagate NaN/null cascades downstream.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Metric drift = perturbation from homeostatic setpoint; smoothing correction = negative feedback; drift signature log = immune memory; clean-drop of corrupted records = graceful apoptosis

repair_strategies.name: homeostatic_smoothing_correction
repair_strategies.description: Proportional re-baselining toward setpoint, log signature for future recognition

repair_strategies.name: graceful_apoptosis_record_drop
repair_strategies.description: Cleanly drop irrecoverable records with audit log; prevent NaN cascades

analogues.problem_structure: Maintaining operational capability when part of the system is degraded or non-functional
analogues.source_solution: Graceful degradation: design for partial failure. When a node falls offline, fall back to next-best routing rather than halting the convoy. OODA loop (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act): cycle faster than the failure can propagate. Pre-positioned alternatives: every primary route has a documented fallback route exercised regularly so it's not theoretical.
analogues.analytics_translation: Healing Agent: when a primary data path fails (parquet read, semantic-layer dimension resolution), fall back to a secondary path (older snapshot, alternate dimension) with reduced fidelity but functional output. Mark the output as degraded so downstream consumers can decide. Run the failure-detection loop faster than failure propagation rate.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Primary data path failure = supply line interruption; fallback = alternate route; OODA cycle time < failure propagation rate = system stays ahead of the failure

repair_strategies.name: fallback_routing_degraded_mode
repair_strategies.description: Switch to secondary data path, mark output as degraded
preconditions: secondary path exists and is current

repair_strategies.name: ooda_accelerated_monitoring
repair_strategies.description: Increase Diagnostic poll frequency to outpace failure propagation

analogues.problem_structure: Establishing the chain of causation between an observed harm and its origin for adjudication
analogues.source_solution: Proximate-and-root cause tracing: distinguish the proximate cause (most immediate trigger) from the root cause (underlying condition that made the trigger consequential). Precedent retrieval: identify the closest analogous prior case and its resolution. Evidentiary thresholds: don't act on insufficient proof — preponderance of evidence vs. beyond reasonable doubt, calibrated to the severity of the action.
analogues.analytics_translation: Healing Agent: when a failure cascades through multiple steps, distinguish the immediate trigger (which row first violated schema) from the root condition (which upstream change introduced the schema drift). Search the Few-Shot Bank for prior healing records on similar failures. Require evidentiary threshold matched to remedy severity — a destructive remedy needs higher confidence than a reversible one.
analogues.structural_isomorphism: Failure cascade = chain of causation; proximate-cause = immediate trigger; root-cause = upstream origin; evidentiary threshold = confidence requirement scaled to remedy reversibility

repair_strategies.name: proximate_root_cause_tracing
repair_strategies.description: Walk failure chain backward to first violation; remediate at root, not symptom
preconditions: failure chain is reconstructable from logs

repair_strategies.name: precedent_retrieval_remediation
repair_strategies.description: Retrieve closest prior healing record from Few-Shot Bank; replay with adjustments
preconditions: matching precedent exists in Few-Shot Bank
context is similar enough to replay
